# DLP Test

> Free, vendor-neutral testing resources for Data Loss Prevention (DLP) software. Synthetic sample data, safe accept-and-discard test endpoints, and tooling for DLP rule authoring. Nothing submitted to the test endpoints is stored, logged, or forwarded; all sample data is fabricated and corresponds to no real person or account.

## Test endpoints

- [HTTP POST Test](https://dlptest.com/http-post/): Submit text or files over plain, unencrypted HTTP to a safe endpoint that discards the body. For network DLP, taps, and passive monitors. API: POST to https://dlptest.com/api/http-post/
- [HTTPS POST Test](https://dlptest.com/https-post/): The same accept-and-discard endpoint over TLS, for SSL-inspecting proxies, ICAP integrations, and SSE/SASE agents.
- [FTP & S3 Test](https://dlptest.com/ftp-test/): Public FTP server (ftp.dlptest.com) with published credentials; uploads are deleted automatically after a short retention period.
- [MCP Server](https://dlptest.com/mcp/): A public Model Context Protocol server (https://mcp.dlptest.com/api/mcp/) that returns synthetic PII/PCI/PHI, for testing whether DLP or CASB tooling can inspect agentic tool traffic.

## Test data

- [Sample Data Library](https://dlptest.com/sample-data/): Curated fake PII/PCI datasets (names + SSNs, credit cards + ZIPs, DOBs + emails) that pass the structural checks DLP engines use (Luhn, SSN area-group-serial). Downloadable as CSV, XLSX, PDF, and DOCX.
- [Data Generator](https://dlptest.com/generate/): Build custom synthetic datasets from PII, PCI, HIPAA, and international field types, with seedable reproducibility. API: POST to https://dlptest.com/api/generate-custom/
- [Regex Test](https://dlptest.com/regex/): A regex workbench for DLP rule authoring — ECMAScript, RE2, and PCRE engines, live match highlighting, and a searchable library of common DLP detection patterns.
